order_blocks.decision: Not built this phase. Building a new order-block detection engine for Forex would be genuinely new strategy-evidence functionality, not a stabilization of existing behavior -- outside this phase's explicit non-negotiable scope ('Do not add new strategies', 'Do not tune ICT thresholds merely to create more setups'). The core ICT sequence (sweep -> displacement -> MSS -> FVG) is already complete and does not depend on order blocks -- FVG already serves as the entry array / execution zone the setup uses. Checkpoint 10's 'FVG and order-block evidence must belong to the active setup' is satisfied for the evidence type that is actually produced (FVG); order blocks remain optional context that is off by default and cannot silently activate.
order_blocks.verified_safe: optional_context.order_block.enabled=False and can_replace_core_sequence=False were confirmed unchanged and read directly from strategies/ict_2022_v2.py -- an order block can never bypass or replace the required core sequence, so there is no path for unrelated/fabricated order-block evidence to complete a setup.
